items.title: An update on Blueprints and the path to UE6
items.en_title: An update on Blueprints and the path to UE6

items.title: GTA 6 hits $3.79 billion in its first day on sale, becoming "the biggest entertainment launch in history"
items.en_title: GTA 6 hits $3.79 billion in its first day on sale, becoming "the biggest entertainment launch in history"

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is now the biggest video game launch in history
